name: Co-Design Bench
notes: The README describes a public Multimodal Editing subset with 96 tasks and 521 acceptance criteria, plus scoring and judging commands. Dataset archives are distributed separately; the reference judge requires an authenticated Claude CLI, Node.js, Playwright, and Chromium.
summary: Co-Design Bench evaluates application revisions made by coding agents from multimodal requests, checking requirements against source code and browser evidence.
